name: SQL Formatter
description: Beautify and minify SQL with keyword casing, indentation and PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle and BigQuery dialects
help: Supports generic SQL, PostgreSQL (arrays, $$ strings), SQL Server ([identifiers], @variables), MySQL (backticks, # comments, \ escapes, ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE), SQLite ([identifiers], ?1 parameters, ON CONFLICT), Oracle (q'[...]' strings, :bind variables, CONNECT BY / START WITH, the / terminator of PL/SQL blocks) and BigQuery (triple-quoted and r'' strings, ARRAY<...> / STRUCT<...> types, QUALIFY, # comments).
Dialect-specific keywords (such as GLOB in SQLite, PRIOR in Oracle and UNNEST in BigQuery) follow the keyword case option too; statements inside PL/SQL blocks are not indented further.
Keywords can be uppercased, lowercased or preserved; “Compact” keeps short argument lists on one line.
Minify removes comments and collapses whitespace while leaving strings and quoted identifiers untouched.
